scope: Separate diagnostic only; never modify original prompt/ref/test or feed diagnostics to model
independence: Draft derived from original prompt by reviewer who also saw same-repository reference. NOT an independent oracle; blind spec review by an independent reviewer required before execution.
truth_domain: Known binary inputs only. No invented X/Z specification. Pure combinational interfaces; no clock/reset assumptions added.

cases.truth: both[i]=in[i]&in[i+1] for i=0..2; any[i]=in[i]|in[i-1] for i=1..3; different[i]=in[i]^in[(i+1)%4] for i=0..3
cases.mask_origin: Original prompt explicitly does not require both[3]/any[0]; not inferred from reference X

cases.truth: For each asserted current state bit, OR its indicated successor bit into next_state. out1=any active S8/S9; out2=any active S7/S9. Zero current state gives all-zero. Multi-hot union interpretation requires independent review before diagnostic implementation.
cases.original_test_gap: one-hot only; no multi-hot correctness claim

cases.truth: matched code => valid1 and mapped value, otherwise valid0/out0
out=0 only for a=b=c=0; all other binary combinations1
exact e06b left, e072 down, e074 right, e075 up; other output bits0; all unmatched inputs all0

future_diagnostic_procedure: Only after review: compile each untouched RefModule with a separate newly approved diagnostic wrapper, drive enumerated binary inputs and sample after an explicitly declared settling interval in that separate diagnostic, compare prompt-derived truth. This does not replace original TB, prove original TB sampling, or turn alias smoke into independence. Freeze wrapper bytes and exact sampling before execution.
stop: Infrastructure/timeout/hash/resource failure stops without retry. Preserve mismatch as negative evidence, no source repair. No extra cases or candidates.
